result.night: Only small isolated groups remain. They conduct sniping, short-range ambushes and concealment rather than a renewed coordinated counterattack.
result.secure_window: 08:30-11:00 on 8-Feb, centered about 09:45, after repeated sweeps confirm that no mutually supporting defense cluster remains.
result.residual: Several dozen concealed individuals may remain after the formal secure declaration, but they are no longer an organized combat system.

support_release: From late morning, selected observation aircraft, direct-fire missions, engineer equipment and destroyer support can be reassigned or replenished. Transit, ammunition state and ASW tasks prevent instantaneous transfer to Kwajalein.
